conventions.attention: Mean over heads then all backbone layers; full-token softmax sliced to patch-patch.
conventions.padding: Keep patch centers within real crop; exclude padded random-walk keys and scoring positions.
conventions.image_pooling: Sum high-region intersection/union/entropy/count across pinned sliding crops; then equal-image averaging, skipping absent aliases.
conventions.cosine_prefilter: Cosine of normalized means of the pinned 80 ImageNet-template patch-text features; fixed threshold0.7.
conventions.alias_maps: VIP template-mean similarity times pinned logit_scale40; replace one parent canonical, softmax across canonical classes.
conventions.protocol: Pinned repository long-edge448/crop336/stride112 retained. Paper appendix shorter-edge336/crop224 is not substituted.
conventions.code_provenance: Paper-rule distillation reimplementation; public pinned VIP has no distillation implementation.
conventions.numeric_repair: Fixed self-Value fallback ONLY on all-masked proxy rows; otherwise pinned VIP equations unchanged. Historical raw VIP could yield NaN.
